dishes.name: Ceviche Clasico
dishes.description: Our signature ceviche features the seasonal catch of the day, marinated in "leche de tigre," with crispy red onions and spicy aji rocoto peppers, served with crunchy canchas, chulpe corn, and a sweet potato wedge.

dishes.name: Ceviche de Hongos
dishes.description: Fresh mushrooms chopped with red onions, spicy aji rocoto peppers, in a vibrant citrus-based marinade.

dishes.name: Tiradito Nikkei
dishes.description: Tuna in a Japanese soy sauce (shoyu), topped with lime, cilantro, fried spring onion, avocado, and crispy leek.

dishes.name: Anticuchos
dishes.description: Charcoal-grilled skewer of either octopus, steak, chicken, or mushrooms in our house Peruvian marinade, served with Peruvian corn, potato wedges, and creamy aji Amarillo sauce.

dishes.name: Papa a la Huancaina
dishes.description: Tender potatoes served with a creamy, spicy Huancaina sauce.

dishes.name: Saltado
dishes.description: Medallions with onions and tomatoes in a soy reduction, served with white rice and crispy fries.

dishes.name: Arroz Chaufa
dishes.description: Wok-fried rice cooked to perfection with your choice of seafood, chicken, or mushrooms, finished with spring onions and a sweet and spicy sauce.

dishes.name: Pollo A La Brasa
dishes.description: Peruvian marinated chicken, slow roasted over wood and charcoal flame, served with our fresh house salad, crispy fries, and ají pollero sauce.

dishes.name: Ensalada de Quinoa y Manzana
dishes.description: White and red quinoa, grated apple and arugula, topped with pecans, raisins, almonds, and freshly grated blue cheese, served with a homemade Dijon mustard vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Chupe de Camarones
dishes.description: Shrimp soup, made with tender shrimp, potatoes, rice, vegetables, and a touch of aji for gentle spice, in a savory broth.

dishes.name: Ceviche Clasico
dishes.description: Fresh catch of the day fish marinated in lime juice, leche de tigre and cilantro, garnished with red onions, served with chulpi corn, Peruvian corn, and sweet potato.

dishes.name: Ceviche Mixto
dishes.description: Fresh catch of the day fish and seafood (shrimp, octopus, and squid) mixed with Peruvian rocoto chili and fresh cilantro. Served with red onions, cancha chulpi, Peruvian corn, and sweet potato.

dishes.name: Ceviche De Mango
dishes.description: Fresh shrimp and catch of the day fish marinated in lime juice and leche de tigre, mixed with a mango, passion fruit reduction, onions, and cilantro. Garnished with chulpi corn and topped with crispy fried wonton. (Ask for GF)

dishes.name: Ceviche De Hongos
dishes.description: Freshly sliced button mushrooms marinated with lime juice and leche de tigre, garnished with red onions and served with sweet potato, cancha chulpi, and Peruvian corn.

dishes.name: Ceviche Trio
dishes.description: A trio of classic and modern ceviches, each highlighting a distinct leche de tigre made with a different Peruvian pepper—classic, ají amarillo, and rocoto. Accompanied by sweet potato, Peruvian corn, red onions, and a touch of cilantro.

dishes.name: Leche De Tigre
dishes.description: A refreshing and flavorful blend of bright citrus, cilantro, and a touch of spice, topped with crispy fried fish.

dishes.name: Inkas Ceviche
dishes.description: Fresh shrimp and catch of the day marinated in lime juice and Peruvian yellow chili leche de Tigre, served with red onions and crunchy calamari, garnished with cilantro, chulpi corn, and Peruvian Corn.

dishes.name: Tiradito Mediterráneo
dishes.description: Thinly sliced catch of the day marinated in leche de tigre and olive oil, finished with Parmesan cheese, cilantro, Botija olives, and avocado.

dishes.name: Croquetas De Yuca
dishes.description: Crispy, golden-fried yuca croquettes with a creamy mashed yuca center, served with ají pollero sauce.

dishes.name: Papa a La Huancaína
dishes.description: Sautéed baby potatoes served with a classic Peruvian Huancaína sauce made with yellow chili, queso fresco, crackers, and a touch of cream.

dishes.name: Chicharrones De Calamar
dishes.description: Crispy, marinated calamari, deep-fried until golden and served with homemade tartar sauce, fresh criolla, and lime. (Ask for GF)

dishes.name: Causa Limeña
dishes.description: Layers of whipped yellow potato, sliced avocado, and shredded chicken mixed with mayonnaise, onions, and chopped lettuce. Garnished with a sliced egg.

dishes.name: Causa De Cocktail De Langostinos
dishes.description: Whipped potato seasoned with Peruvian yellow chili and lime juice, layered with sliced avocado and chopped shrimp tossed in a homemade cocktail sauce. Garnished with chalaquita onion.

dishes.name: Tiradito Nikkei Inkas Style
dishes.description: Thinly sliced tuna topped with a Nikkei sauce made with soy sauce, lime juice, togarashi, oyster sauce, sesame seeds, and sesame oil. Served with diced avocado, lime, cilantro and wakame seaweed.

dishes.name: Tartar De Atún Y Salmón
dishes.description: Diced fresh tuna and salmon marinated in a Nikkei sauce (ginger, soy sauce, citrus, and hondashi), garnished with fresh arugula, walnuts, and almonds. (Ask for GF)

dishes.name: Inka Maki
dishes.description: Japanese sushi rice and nori seaweed rolled with fresh tuna, avocado, and cream cheese, topped with sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Maki Acevichado
dishes.description: Crispy panko-shrimp and avocado rolled in Japanese sushi rice and nori seaweed, topped with thinly sliced tuna and acevichado sauce (leche de tigre, togarashi, and homemade mayonnaise).

dishes.name: Machu Pichu Maki
dishes.description: Inka’s signature roll featuring crispy panko-fried shrimp, creamy avocado, and mildly spicy salmon tartare, topped with eel sauce and crispy wontons.

dishes.name: Ensalada De Quinoa Y Manzana
dishes.description: A blend of white, black and red Peruvian quinoa, grated apple, and arugula, topped with toasted pecans, raisins, and almonds. Tossed in a homemade Dijon mustard vinaigrette and finished with crumbled blue cheese.

dishes.name: Hongos Saltados
dishes.description: Stir-fried button and shiitake mushrooms with red onions and tomatoes in a gluten-free soy sauce reduction with a touch of cilantro. Served with crispy fries and white rice.

dishes.name: Coliflor a La Brasa
dishes.description: Tender roasted cauliflower marinated in Peruvian spices, topped with ají amarillo sauce and chimichurri. Accompanied by sautéed bell peppers, zucchini, asparagus, mushrooms, and baby potato flambéed with white wine.

dishes.name: Peruvian Ratatouille
dishes.description: Roasted zucchini, tomatoes, white onions, bell peppers, and garlic, tossed with mixed quinoa and fresh parsley. Finished with a balsamic reduction, ají amarillo chimichurri, and crispy sweet potato threads.

dishes.name: Lomo Saltado
dishes.description: Tender filet mignon stir-fried with red onions and tomato in a soy sauce reduction, finished with a touch of cilantro. Served with crispy fries and white rice.

dishes.name: Ají De Gallina
dishes.description: Shredded chicken breast simmered in a creamy Peruvian yellow chilli sauce, served with boiled potatoes and white rice, topped with an egg slice and nuts. (Ask for Nut Free)

dishes.name: Seco De Asado De Tira
dishes.description: Slow-cooked short ribs in a cilantro sauce with peas and carrots, served with a seared tacu tacu (Peruvianstyle blend of chickpeas and white rice), garnished with fresh criolla onion.

dishes.name: Fetuccini Al Pesto
dishes.description: Fettuccine tossed in our homemade Peruvian pesto sauce (basil, spinach, confit garlic, and cream), finished with shredded Parmesan cheese. Grilled Chicken +$14 | Grilled Shrimp +$16 | Lomo Saltado +$24

dishes.name: Risotto Al Aji Amarillo
dishes.description: Creamy Arborio rice slowly cooked with white wine and Peruvian yellow chili sauce, finished with cream, butter, and shredded Parmesan cheese. Grilled Mushroom +$10 (vegetarian) | Grilled Chicken +$14 | Grilled Shrimp +$16 | Lomo Saltado +$24

dishes.name: Pasta a La Huancaina
dishes.description: Fettuccine pasta tossed in a creamy Huancaína sauce (Peruvian yellow chili, queso fresco, and cream), topped with shredded Parmesan cheese. Mushroom Saltado +$10 | Chicken Saltado +$14 | Lomo Saltado +$24

dishes.name: Arroz Con Pollo
dishes.description: A classic homemade dish of cilantro-infused green rice mixed with peas and carrots, served with chicken breast, huancaína sauce, and fresh criolla. (Ask for GF)

dishes.name: Seafood (Fried)
dishes.description: (Calamari, Fish, Shrimp) (Ask for GF Seafood)

dishes.name: Arroz Con Mariscos
dishes.description: Peruvian-style rice sauteed with fresh seafood (Shrimp, scallops, octopus, and calamari) white wine reduction, tossed with salsa madre, garnished with cilantro and served with fresh criolla onion.

dishes.name: Pollo a La Brasa
dishes.description: Peruvian marinated chicken, slow roasted and served with crispy fries, a fresh salad, and our signature ají pollero sauce.

dishes.name: Salmón Con Mantequilla De Naranja
dishes.description: Seared salmon glazed with orange butter, served over a whipped lúcuma and sweet potato purée, accompanied by grilled asparagus. Topped with crispy sweet potato threads.

dishes.name: Pulpo a La Parrilla
dishes.description: Tender grilled octopus served with baby potatoes, asparagus, zucchinni, complemented by house-made chimichurri, ají pollero, and fresh lime.

dishes.name: Skirt Steak
dishes.description: Grilled outside skirt steak served with roasted baby potatoes, smoky chimichurri, and ají amarillo. Served with (sautéed) seasonal vegetables.

dishes.name: Raviolis De Langosta
dishes.description: Handmade raviolis filled with tender lobster and ricotta, topped with creamy salsa madre. Finished with fresh chimichurri-infused lobster, parsley, and Parmesan cheese.

dishes.name: Pescado Entero
dishes.description: Whole red snapper marinated in Peruvian spices and deep-fried until golden and crispy, served with tostones and fresh criolla onion.

dishes.name: Chuleta a La Parrilla
dishes.description: Slow-cooked pork chop, finished on the grill and topped with rosemary and confit garlic butter. Served with passion fruit-infused mashed sweet potatoes and fresh arugula.

dishes.name: Filete De Pescado
dishes.description: Catch of the day fish filet served with seasonal vegetables, olive oil and white wine, finished with a drizzle of ají amarillo, leche de tigre, and arugula.

dishes.name: Platanos Dulce Fritos
dishes.description: Fried sweet plantains drizzled with honey.

dishes.name: Camote Frito
dishes.description: Sweet potato fries.

dishes.name: Ensalada Fresca
dishes.description: Fresh lettuce, tomato, avocado, onions, and homemade vinaigrette on the side.

dishes.name: Sautéed Vegetables
dishes.description: Seasonal vegetables sautéed in olive oil and white wine.

dishes.name: Yuca Frita
dishes.description: Crispy fried cassava sticks.

dishes.name: Tacu Tacu
dishes.description: Golden-seared blend of rice and chickpeas, served with a side of criolla onion.

dishes.name: Scallops
dishes.description: Sauteed in butter, white wine, and finished with grated parmesan (2 per order).

dishes.name: Shot De Leche De Tigre
dishes.description: A fresh, flavorful shot of fluke, marinated in a zesty homemade "leche de tigre".

dishes.name: Mini Causas
dishes.description: Two mini causes filled with chicken, yellow potatos and avocado.

dishes.name: Inka Maki
dishes.description: Tuna, avocado, cream cheese, sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Empanadas
dishes.description: Choice of cheese, beef, or chicken (3 per order).

dishes.name: Chicken Wontons
dishes.description: Fried wonton filled with chicken and served with our homemade sweet and sour sauce (3 per order).

dishes.name: Alfajor
dishes.description: Two homemade shortbread cookies sandwiched between a manjar center.

dishes.name: Crema Volteada
dishes.description: A Peruvian take on flan, this smooth and creamy dessert features a rich caramel glaze and a delicate custard base.

dishes.name: Tres Leches Del Día
dishes.description: A rotating selection of our summer inspired Homemade Tres Leches, a moist, fluffy sponge cake, soaked in a blend of evaporated milk, condensed milk, and whole milk.

dishes.name: Dessert Maki
dishes.description: A traditional Nikkei maki turned into dessert, 5 sweet rice makis with our seasonal fresh fruit.

dishes.name: Tarta De Calabaza
dishes.description: A crisp, cookie-like crust filled with a tangy homemade pumpkin cream, topped with a lightly torched meringue.

dishes.name: Suspiro Caliente
dishes.description: A silky caramel-like custard nestled in a moist dulce de leche and vanilla cake, topped with a delicate meringue, a touch of cinnamon, and served with vanilla ice cream. (20 minute bake time)

dishes.name: Crocante De Lucuma (Nuts)
dishes.description: Our homemade Lucuma ice cream with a butterscotch pecan brownie, layered with meringue, chocolate ganache, butterscotch, and a pecan praline.
